Read the guide → A website search engines can access What to review in crawling, indexability and content. Read the guide → Measurement connected to your business Distinguish visits, inquiries and opportunities. Read the guide → B2B industrial lead generation How to attract buyers and generate better opportunities Answers for marketing leaders, sales teams and industrial business owners who want to turn their expertise into new sales conversations. Win industrial customers and enter new markets How can an industrial company find customers beyond referrals and trade shows? Start by defining which companies can buy, what problem you solve and which locations you can serve. Your website should explain applications, capabilities and purchasing criteria, with a clear path to request a quote. At Mood, we build that foundation to capture demand from search engines and AI answers, combining it with other channels when scope calls for it. Content complements your sales work and relationships that already perform. How can we attract B2B buyers looking for solutions who don't yet know our brand? Organize content around problems and applications as well as product names. A manufacturer or distributor can explain how to choose a solution, which operating conditions to assess and what details are needed for a quote. Mood connects those answers with your commercial pages. You don't need to know the term GEO to engage us: we start with how a new buyer discovers you. How can we find distributors or wholesale customers for our products? Distinguish distributors from end buyers. A partner page should explain available product lines, coverage, the distributor profile, support and collaboration requirements you can disclose. The form should identify the company, location and sales channel. Mood can work on visibility and the contact journey; distributor approval and commercial terms remain with your team. Can we attract industrial customers in other Mexican cities? We can plan a regional strategy where you genuinely have supply or service capacity. We first document coverage, logistics, installation and support, as applicable. We create regional pages only when they offer distinct, useful information; repeating the same text with a different city doesn't help buyers. The assessment determines which markets and pages to prioritize. Turn visits into quote requests sales can use Why does our website get visits but very few quote requests? There may be several issues: poorly matched visitors, an unclear offer, missing technical information or friction when contacting you. Total traffic alone cannot identify the cause. We review search queries, entry pages, calls to action and available inquiries to prioritize changes. If measurement isn't configured, we first define how to record those steps. How can we attract volume buyers and reduce consumer inquiries? Be explicit about whom you serve: industries, applications, coverage and minimum orders, where applicable. Content and forms can ask for company, intended use, approximate volume and location. This helps guide and evaluate inquiries but won't eliminate every poor-fit contact. Mood agrees with sales on the conditions an opportunity must meet before reporting it as qualified. What information does sales need to qualify an industrial lead? As a starting point: an identifiable company, a specific need, product or application, a serviceable location, project scale and estimated timing. It also helps to understand the contact's role in the purchase and agree on a next step. Criteria are adapted to your business. A corporate email or catalog download alone doesn't establish buying intent or budget. How can content help when sales take months and involve procurement, engineering and leadership? Each participant needs different information: engineering assesses technical suitability, procurement compares supply terms and leadership reviews impact and risk. We propose content your contact can share internally, such as selection guides, verified data sheets and documented cases. Sales can use it in follow-up. Its contribution is evaluated alongside opportunity progress, without attributing an entire sale to a single read. Get considered in Google and AI answers How can buyers find us when searching for suppliers on Google or ChatGPT? Publish clear information about what you supply, applications, coverage and demonstrable capabilities on accessible, interconnected pages. Mood reviews that foundation, organizes buyer questions and observes when the brand appears or its website is cited. Repeating keywords isn't enough, and we can't guarantee recommendations. The work aims to make useful, verifiable information available for evaluating your business. Why do our competitors appear in AI answers while we don't? One answer can't reveal the cause. We first repeat a defined sample of questions and record the product, date, context and cited sources. Then we review differences in public information: offer clarity, accessible pages, question coverage and relevant references. This supports prioritization; it doesn't mean we know the algorithm or that copying a competitor will produce the same result. Is uploading our PDF catalog enough for buyers to find us? A catalog can support evaluation, but your website should also explain products, applications and selection criteria on browsable pages. That lets buyers reach a specific answer and contact you without going through the entire document. Mood assesses which catalog information deserves a page and retains downloadable data sheets as supporting material, with specifications validated by your team. What kind of agency can help generate B2B opportunities if we already have marketing and sales teams? Look for a team that understands your technical offer, agrees on qualification criteria with sales and connects content, visibility and measurement with business goals. Mood works with B2B companies that have a website and follow-up capacity. GEO scope covers visibility and content; CRM, automation, sales training and campaigns are defined separately when needed. Share your website and the customers you want to attract so we can assess the fit. GEO service scope and delivery What is GEO, and how is it different from SEO? GEO, or Generative Engine Optimization, focuses on improving how a business may be discovered and represented in AI-generated answers. SEO helps search engines find and understand its pages. Both rely on useful content, technical access and evidence; GEO adds observation of answers, mentions and citations. Can you guarantee ChatGPT will recommend my business? No. Answers change with the question, context, product and timing. We commit to agreed scope, deliverables and measurement—not a fixed ranking or guaranteed recommendation. Do you offer GEO for industrial manufacturers and distributors? Yes. We start with the applications, products, coverage, capabilities and criteria their buyers use to evaluate suppliers. We prioritize commercial and technical questions the company can answer with verifiable information. Which AI tools can we monitor for brand visibility? We can define a question sample for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity and Google's AI experiences, depending on available access and agreed scope. We document the product or API, date and context; one observation doesn't represent what all users see. Do I need to rebuild my website? Not necessarily. We first check whether content is accessible, whether it explains your offer clearly and which pages are missing. The proposal may prioritize changes to existing pages, new content or specific technical improvements. How long does the service take, and what does it cost? It depends on the site's condition, market, available pages and sources, and the work required. After reviewing your goal, we define scope, investment, timing and responsibilities in writing. There is no guaranteed date for appearing in AI answers. How will you measure its contribution to the business? We separate indexing and searches, observed mentions and citations, referred visits and received inquiries. Where CRM and measurement data allow, we review sales opportunities. A mention is not presented as an attributed sale. Will you publish AI content without review? Not as part of this approach. AI can support research and drafts; claims, specifications and brand information need human review and sources. We agree the approval process with your team. The next step Let's talk about how your buyers find you. Share your website, what your business sells and whom you want to reach. We'll review the goal to define a scope and prepare a proposal if we're a good fit. Ask about GEO visibility Mention GEO in the form message. Sending an inquiry does not commit you to a service. Technical reference: Google Search Central: AI features and your website . Google retains SEO fundamentals for its AI experiences. This documentation does not, by itself, explain how other providers work.

# PHASA: SEO, GEO and AI for marketing and sales | Mood Agency
https://mood-agency.com/en/case-studies/phasa/

PHASA · B2B industry · Digital transformation in progress PHASA. SEO, GEO and AI to connect marketing and sales. PHASA wanted to improve its digital visibility, put AI to work and automate processes. Mood developed a strategy combining search visibility, team training and sales follow-up in HubSpot. Explore the challenge and solution ↓ Let's talk about your project Client PHASA Industry Rubber solutions · B2B Market Mexico Scope SEO/GEO + AI + HubSpot + training The project combines strategy, training and process design to support PHASA’s transformation. The challenge The strategy SEO & GEO AI for marketing Sales and HubSpot Automation Progress 01 / The client’s challenge An established business. An opportunity to connect its digital operations. PHASA is a Mexican company specializing in rubber products and materials for industrial applications. It already had a technical catalog, active campaigns, an experienced sales team and HubSpot in use. Its next step was to make better use of those resources. The client identified three related needs: gain visibility on Google and in AI-generated answers; use artificial intelligence to reduce manual work; and make stronger use of its CRM to follow through on sales opportunities. Search visibility to strengthen The audit found organic demand and pages already appearing in search, alongside opportunities to improve click-through, organize content around buying intent and explain product applications more clearly. Connect acquisition with sales Measurement combined actions of different business value. Visits and clicks needed to be distinguished from valid leads, and acquisition needed to be connected with deal progress in HubSpot. AI applied to daily work Marketing and sales needed practical AI skills for their work: producing technical content, analyzing information, preparing follow-ups and keeping the CRM up to date. 02 / Mood’s approach Develop the technology and team adoption together. We proposed two parallel workstreams: improve the digital foundation of PHASA, and train the people who produce content, respond to prospects and manage opportunities. Search visibility and automation would then be supported by a clear sales process and a team able to use it. Diagnose Review search performance, analytics, campaigns and the CRM to understand demand, measurement and the obstacles to consistent follow-up. Design and train Define SEO/GEO architecture and working processes; teach the team to apply AI using brand context, technical information and sales data. Automate by priority Identify repetitive tasks and establish rules, owners and controls before integrating channels or activating automated workflows. The strategy needed to cover the full journey: help buyers find PHASA, understand the solution and receive clear sales follow-up. 03 / The solution: search visibility Turn technical expertise into content that helps buyers find and choose PHASA. We started with an audit of Google Analytics, Search Console and Google Ads. Reviewing them together helped identify categories with demand and focus the strategy on industrial buying questions: which material to choose, what application it serves and which specifications matter. SEO: address search intent We designed an architecture for PHASA organized by categories, products and applications. Priority pages, technical guides, titles, descriptions and an internal linking plan were prepared to help buyers move from a need to a quote request. GEO: make the information easier for AI to understand The strategy also addresses how information is presented to AI answer engines: direct explanations, frequently asked questions, material comparisons and structured data. The aim is to help those tools interpret the technical content and use it as a reference. The prepared editorial work includes a home page, a pilot page, six category pages and five guides, together with FAQs and publishing guidelines. Implementation is organized in stages, with the client validating technical information. Measurement was designed around business outcomes: distinguish interactions from valid leads and track progress from lead to opportunity and sale. 04 / The solution: marketing team Train the team to create, analyze and work with AI. The search strategy needed a team able to sustain it. We delivered training tailored to PHASA, using sessions, exercises and guides to apply AI to content strategy, analysis and recurring tasks. Provide context before creating Training covered brand briefs, buyer profiles, problems, objections and buying stages. This foundation guided messages, content and calls to action using ChatGPT and Claude. Build repeatable processes With Claude and Cowork, the team learned to organize documents, create reusable instructions—skills—and connect tools. Practice covered audits, data queries, campaign planning and file management. Analyze and review critically Sessions demonstrated analytics queries and behavior analysis with Clarity. Training included human review, technical validation and access permissions for using AI with work information. The aim was to leave the team with a repeatable method: brand context → buyer need → content or analysis → review → next action. Supporting materials let participants return to the process after each session. 05 / The solution: sales team Use HubSpot and Breeze to turn customer history into next actions. PHASA was already using HubSpot. The challenge was to make better use of it in daily follow-up: maintain useful stages and dates, record conversation context and ensure every opportunity has an owner and a next action. Following the CRM review, sales training focused on the daily work of salespeople and managers. The program covered AI applied to HubSpot, including Breeze—HubSpot’s AI—and Claude or ChatGPT through authorized connectors, depending on the features available in the portal. From contact to close: a shared process 01 Contact Find and record the customer without duplicating information. 02 Opportunity Create the deal and assign an owner. 03 Quote Record the value, reference and a realistic close date. 04 Follow-up Schedule the next task and record the context. 05 Close Update the outcome and record the loss reason when applicable. AI for salespeople Exercises for prioritizing tasks, finding quotes without follow-up, summarizing history before a call, preparing messages and turning notes into structured records. AI for managers Prompts and a pipeline review routine to identify stalled opportunities, analyze loss reasons and define actions for each salesperson using CRM data. Controlled practice Guides, batch-editing exercises and assignments between sessions. Information is queried and reviewed first; changes are validated with the process owner. 06 / Process automation Define what to automate, which data it needs and who takes over. Training and CRM discipline form the foundation of the AI Sales Operating System proposed for PHASA: an architecture connecting acquisition, response, quotation, follow-up and analysis. Diagnosis and design help prioritize workflows before they are configured. Priority automations Create a follow-up task when a quote is sent. Flag opportunities with no recent activity. Identify overdue close dates for review. Prepare a weekly pipeline summary for the manager. Evolution of the sales system The design includes AI-assisted WhatsApp response, request qualification, routing to a salesperson, development of the existing quotation tool and reporting dashboards. Each component has a defined role in the sales journey and a staged rollout. These workflows form part of the implementation proposal. Activation depends on PHASA’s validation, data quality and licensed capabilities. The goal is to reduce repetitive tasks so salespeople can spend more time understanding needs and supporting buying decisions. 07 / Project progress A shared strategy and teams trained to put it into daily practice. The work delivered brings together digital diagnosis, SEO/GEO architecture and content, AI training for marketing and sales training with HubSpot. Connecting these workstreams is Mood’s central contribution: defining how to attract relevant demand, work with it and prepare follow-up for automation. Strategy and content prepared Channel diagnosis, a search-led commercial architecture, technical content and guidelines for prioritized publishing. Applied training for two teams Marketing worked on context, content, analysis and AI-supported processes. Sales worked on follow-up, data and productivity in HubSpot. Automation roadmap defined Processes, tasks and integration opportunities identified to progress from training to staged implementation. Project in progress · Updated November 20, 2026. The sessions and deliverables described are documented; content publication and automation progress in stages. Impact on search visibility, productivity and sales will be evaluated through subsequent measurement. Marketing + sales + technology Does your business need to connect these processes? We can help identify gaps between acquisition and sales, the skills your team needs and the processes worth automating with AI. Let’s discuss your business Visit PHASA ↗
